A building party with strangers?

People are going to recognize you immediately, Monica.
I will wear simple and discreet clothes.
You are truly incorrigible and full of energy!
Are you coming with me, my dear Gabriel?
All right Monica, I will accompany you tonight.

examples.trans: I'll go with you to the station.

meanings.note: tu peux m'accompagner? = can you come with me?

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: devant la caméra = in front of the camera

examples.trans: To eat in front of the camera.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: J'ai perdu un ami très cher.
examples.trans: I've lost a very dear friend.

meanings.note: before the noun: un ami très cher
after the noun or after être

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.
Baissez les yeux devant la duchesse!
examples.trans: Lower your eyes before the duchess!
I'll wait for you in front of the cinema.

meanings.en: in front of, before (a place or person)
meanings.note: devant la porte = in front of the door

examples.text: Il n'y a rien entre nous.

meanings.note: entre toi et moi = between you and me
also as an answer: Exactement! = That's right!
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

examples.text: On fait la fête ce soir!
Il y a beaucoup de gens.
examples.trans: There are a lot of people.

meanings.note: always plural: des gens, les gens

examples.trans: Did you find an interesting guide?

examples.text: Le rôle est pour un homme.
examples.trans: The part is for a man.
They are in front of the building.

examples.text: Je dois régler ce problème immédiatement.
examples.trans: I must settle this problem immediately.

examples.text: Je ne laisse pas mes enfants à une inconnue!
examples.trans: I don't leave my children with a stranger!

meanings.note: feminine: une inconnue; also adjective: unknown
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
un bon livre = a good book; note 'une livre' (feminine) is a pound

examples.text: Je vais vous donner mon livre.
examples.trans: I am going to give you my book.

meanings.note: ni l'un ni l'autre = neither one nor the other

examples.text: Ni leur accorder la moindre attention.
examples.trans: Nor give them the slightest attention.

meanings.note: c'est normal = that's normal / fair enough

examples.text: Un prisonnier qui chante, c'est très original.
examples.trans: A singing prisoner, that is very original.

meanings.note: porter malheur = to bring bad luck; porter bonheur = to bring good luck

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.note: faire une promenade = to take a walk

examples.trans: Can I offer you a coffee?

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.

examples.trans: How old would you say she is?

examples.text: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir.

meanings.note: bonne soirée = have a nice evening
before the verb; t' before a vowel
c'est tellement stupide = it's so stupid
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi

examples.text: Tout homme serait troublé devant toi.
examples.trans: Any man would be flustered in front of you.

meanings.en: trouve quelque chose = think of something

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
venir de: je viens de la Côte d'Azur
venir de + infinitive: je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived
vivre à Paris = to live in Paris
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir

examples.text: Je vendrais encore des vêtements dans le Sud.
examples.trans: I would still be selling clothes in the South.

meanings.note: place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les

examples.trans: She has a lot of energy.
